1484. Final Keyword: Immutable 2D Point

70

Hard

Problem Statement:
Create a program that simulates an immutable class representing a Point in a 2D plane. The class should use the final keyword to ensure immutability.
You need to create a class Point with the following specifications:
Two private final fields x and y representing the coordinates of the point.
A constructor that initializes these fields.
Getter methods to retrieve the values of x and y.
A method distance(Point other) to calculate the distance between the current point and another point.
Ensure that the Point class is immutable.
input_spec:
The first line contains two integers representing the coordinates of the first point.
The second line contains two integers representing the coordinates of the second point.
output_spec: Print the distance between the two points, rounded to 2 decimal places.
